SELECT res
FROM (
    SELECT ABS(SUM("Combined Digester Feed Flow"))   / 60 AS res 
    FROM "mqtt" 
    WHERE $timeFilter 
    GROUP BY time(1d , 18h30m)
)

SELECT res
FROM (
    SELECT ABS(SUM("Combined Digester Feed Flow"))   / 60 AS res 
    FROM "mqtt" 
    WHERE $timeFilter 
    GROUP BY time(1h , 0m)
)

targets.rawSql:
WITH sperate AS (
  SELECT
    date_fed_into_eq_tank,
    pressmud_quantity,
    cow_manure_quantity,
    borewell_water,
    filtrate_water
  FROM
    user_feedstockdata
  WHERE
    form_id = 3
    AND eq_tank_fed = '${EQTankFed:raw}'
    AND '${EQTankFed:raw}' != 'Total'
    AND $__timeFilter(date_fed_into_eq_tank)
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    date_fed_into_eq_tank,
    COALESCE(SUM(pressmud_quantity), 0) AS pressmud_quantity,
    COALESCE(SUM(cow_manure_quantity), 0) AS cow_manure_quantity,
    COALESCE(SUM(borewell_water), 0) AS borewell_water,
    COALESCE(SUM(filtrate_water), 0) AS filtrate_water
  FROM
    user_feedstockdata
  WHERE
    form_id = 3
    AND '${EQTankFed:raw}' = 'Total'
    AND $__timeFilter(date_fed_into_eq_tank)
  GROUP BY
    date_fed_into_eq_tank
)
-- select * from total;
SELECT
  COALESCE(s.date_fed_into_eq_tank, t.date_fed_into_eq_tank) AS "Date Fed into EQ Tank",
  COALESCE(s.pressmud_quantity, t.pressmud_quantity) AS "Pressmud quantity (tons)",
  COALESCE(s.cow_manure_quantity, t.cow_manure_quantity) AS "Cow manure quantity (tons)",
  COALESCE(s.borewell_water, t.borewell_water) AS "Borewell water (m3)",
  COALESCE(s.filtrate_water, t.filtrate_water) AS "Filtrate water (m3)"
FROM
  sperate s
FULL JOIN
  total t
ON
  s.date_fed_into_eq_tank = t.date_fed_into_eq_tank
ORDER BY "Date Fed into EQ Tank" ASC;

    END AS "Volatile_Acids (mg/l Acetic Acid)"
  FROM
    user_labtestdata
  WHERE
    form_id = 2
    AND location = 'digester 6: 202-P-12'
    AND $__timeFilter(time_of_sample_collection)
)
SELECT
  a.time_of_sample_collection,
  va."Volatile_Acids (mg/l Acetic Acid)" / a."Alkalinity (mg/l CaCO3)" AS "digester 6: 202-P-12"
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM
      alkalinity
    WHERE
      "Alkalinity (mg/l CaCO3)" is NOT NULL
  ) a
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM
      volatileacids
    WHERE
      "Volatile_Acids (mg/l Acetic Acid)" is NOT NULL
  ) va ON a.time_of_sample_collection = va.time_of_sample_collection;

SELECT 
    time_of_sample_collection,
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'pH%' THEN result
    END AS "pH (s.u.)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'Temperature%' THEN result
    END AS "Temperature (Celsius)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'Alkalinity%' THEN result
    END AS "Alkalinity (mg/l CaCO3)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'COD%' THEN result
    END AS "COD (mg/l)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'Volatile Acids%' THEN result
    END AS "Volatile_Acids (mg/l Acetic Acid)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'VSS%' THEN result
    END AS "VSS (mg/l)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'TSS%' THEN result
    END AS "TSS (mg/l)",
    CASE 
        WHEN type_of_lab_test LIKE 'TKN%' THEN result
    END AS "TKN (mg/l)"
FROM 
    user_labtestdata 
WHERE 
    form_id = 2
    AND location = '${LabTestLocation:raw}'
AND
  $__timeFilter(time_of_sample_collection);

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', start_time) AS "Day",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_time - start_time)) / 3600) AS "Total Run Time (hours)"
FROM
  user_equipmentruntimedata
WHERE
  form_id = 6
  AND
  equipment_tag = '${EquipmentTag:raw}'
  AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY
  "Day"
ORDER BY "Day" ASC;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', failure_time) AS "Day",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (restore_time - failure_time)) / 3600) AS "Total Power Outage Duration (hours)",
  COUNT(failure_time) AS "Total Power Outage Count"
FROM
  user_poweroutagedata 
WHERE
  form_id = 8
  AND $__timeFilter(failure_time)
GROUP BY
  "Day";
